clips.title: The story
paras: Within the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak, three druidic keys open the enchanted hoard.

High on Stonetalon Peak, night elf druids built the Talon Den as a sanctuary and a storehouse for powerful relics. They hid the treasures behind several layers of protection. Three enchanted locks seal the hoard: the Barrow Key, the Sleepers' Key, and the Claw Key. Each key lies in its own druidic cache, shaped like a torch and hidden in the winding tunnels of the barrow den.

The druids kept the keys guarded and out of easy reach. Near the barrow entrance lies the Gatekeeper's Key, needed to open the cache that holds the Claw Key. The Claw Key is vital to breaking the druids' seal and claiming the riches hidden deep within the mountain.
